basic_details.job_title: NAM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Accounting Clerk, Multi Purpose Worker and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Seven contract posts with monthly remuneration from Rs. 13500/- to Rs. 17850/- are open at the Pathanamthitta District Programme Management & Supporting Unit of the National AYUSH Mission (NAM): Accounting Clerk, Yoga Instructor, Multi Purpose Worker (AMMU), Multi Purpose Health Worker, Ayurveda Therapist (Male &Female), Multi Purpose Worker (NCD) and Multi Purpose Worker (Physiotherapy Unit). Applications must be submitted online at careers.nam.kerala.gov.in by 3 December 2026. The age limit is 40 years for most posts and 50 years for Yoga Instructor, counted on the last date for application.

content_sections.heading: NAM Pathanamthitta Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention an application fee, and it prints no number of vacancies for five of the seven posts.

Accounting Clerk, Yoga Instructor, Multi Purpose Worker (AMMU), Multi Purpose Health Worker, Ayurveda Therapist (Male &Female), Multi Purpose Worker (NCD), Multi Purpose Worker (Physiotherapy Unit)
1 Accounting Clerk and 1 Multi Purpose Worker (Physiotherapy Unit); the other five posts are marked "Anticipated"
Monthly Remuneration Rs. 13500/- to Rs. 17850/- (varies by post)

content_sections.heading: About NAM Pathanamthitta
content_sections.text: The District Programme Management and Supporting Unit of the National AYUSH Mission works from Orikompil Building, Second floor, Melevettippuram, Pathanamthitta - 689645, Kerala. The notice is issued under the signature of the District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, Pathanamthitta, and its email address is printed as [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice prints a number for two posts (1 each, 2 in total); the remaining five posts are listed as "Anticipated". The notice states that the number of vacancies is only indicative and not guaranteed. No category-wise break-up is given. All seven posts are on a contract basis. The notice gives no further pay details, such as allowances or increments, and does not state the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Typing in English and Malayalam Working experience in AYUSH & Health sector Exposure in Social sector schemes The notice lists desirable qualifications only for the Accounting Clerk post. Candidates who hold an equivalent qualification must produce the equivalency certificate along with the application; failure to submit it will result in rejection of the application. The age is counted as on the last date for application (3 December 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

Ayurveda Therapist Course conducted by Govt of Kerala /DAME / Ayurveda Panchakarma Technician course with one year duration conducted by CCRAS Cheruruthy
GNM Nursing approved by recognized Nursing School with Kerala Nursing & midwife council registration; MS Office

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Pathanamthitta Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the eligibility criteria of the post given in the notice. Submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in/index.php . Fill in every detail clearly; incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. If you hold an equivalent qualification, produce the equivalency certificate along with the application. Submit the online application on or before 03/12/2026. Documents named in the notice: Equivalency certificate (only for candidates with an equivalent qualification) Original documents, to be produced at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection procedure includes Skill Test/Written Test & Interview as the case may be. A written test will be conducted for a particular post when there are 20 or more applicants for that post. At the interview, the particulars given in the application form are checked against the original documents; if they do not tally, the candidature will be rejected. The notice does not give dates for the test or the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NAM Pathanamthitta Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice prints 1 vacancy for Accounting Clerk and 1 for Multi Purpose Worker (Physiotherapy Unit); the other five posts are marked "Anticipated", and the number of vacancies is only indicative and not guaranteed.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Accounting Clerk post?
faq.answer: A B com degree from a recognised university, a Recognised Diploma in Computer Application and a Certificate in Tally; typing in English and Malayalam, working experience in AYUSH & Health sector and exposure in social sector schemes are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not exceed 50 years for Yoga Instructor and not exceed 40 years for the other six posts, as on the last date for application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration is 17000/- for Accounting Clerk and Ayurveda Therapist, 14000/- for Yoga Instructor, 15000/- for Multi Purpose Worker (AMMU) and Multi Purpose Health Worker, 17850/- for Multi Purpose Worker (NCD) and 13500/- for Multi Purpose Worker (Physiotherapy Unit).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in/index.php by 3 December 2026, with an equivalency certificate if you hold an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection procedure includes Skill Test/Written Test & Interview as the case may be.

faq.question: Q8. When will a written test be held?
faq.answer: A written test will be conducted for a particular post when there are 20 or more applicants for that post.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No, the notice invites applications for the posts on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Is nursing council registration needed?
faq.answer: Yes, for Multi Purpose Health Worker and Multi Purpose Worker (NCD), the nursing qualification must come with Kerala Nursing & midwife council registration.
